question: According to the Indian Constitution, who can reserve a bill passed by the State Legislative Assembly for the assent of the President?

options.text: Speaker of the State Legislative Assembly
Opposition parties in the State Legislative

solution:
The correct answer is __**Governor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• According to Article 200 of the Indian Constitution, the **Governor** of a state has the power to reserve a bill passed by the State Legislative Assembly for the assent of the **President of India**.
 
• The Governor exercises this power when the bill in question conflicts with the provisions of the Constitution, central laws, or may affect the larger interests of the country.
